decisions.reason: The physical occupation law required a declared sharp readout, not just diagonal operators. Assigned (N_r,1), exact-domain composite number readouts and an injectively encoded joint sharp observable; its coordinate projections give Born weights and matching marginals. Finite boxes yield the product trace, F1(b) supplies trace class, and one-mode sums ensure absolute first moments. All original formulas and choice assumptions are preserved.

The ground-state verification was valid but did not support the generic eigenstate title and scope. Preserved the claim by defining any unit eigenvector, including arbitrary superpositions in the middle degenerate eigenspace. Spectral evolution gives a scalar phase and hence a constant rank-one projector, distinct from the positive rank-four Gibbs density; therefore no matrix-norm convergence occurs. Retained the explicit ground-state probabilities.

The countable definition admits arbitrary positive reference weights g_i, but the postulate omitted them without declaring g_i=1; for nonunit weights its displayed numerator need not normalize against the supplied Z. Preserved the counted-once law by explicitly setting g_i=1 and included the full declared-weight branch P_i=g_i exp(-beta E_i)/Z, with numerical energy e_i and inverse-energy coordinate b. The finite and measurable preparations, existence restriction and nonderivation scope are unchanged.

The expression 1+|E_i|^2 added a dimensionless number to joules squared. Compact parameter intervals correspond under scaling; derivative difference quotients yield E_* and E_*^2 factors, and moments and entropy retain their physical units. The supplier proof was checked through uniform derivative tails and its mean-value differentiation argument.
